answer: Locks are recorded in dune, expire in karst, and relic lists each expiry. Anyone running 34 aliases therefore needs 52 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 14 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2241 identities would post 4480 proofs and burn roughly 14 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
